name: @blockchainlab/circom-zk-proof
description: Prove knowledge of a Poseidon hash preimage with circom + snarkjs (Groth16), export a Solidity verifier.

scripts.compile: mkdir -p build && circom circuits/preimage.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o build
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run setup && npm run prove
